invariant: Java resolves state stereotypes in three independent stages. CommandCreateState maps only choice, fork, join, start, end, history, and history* case-insensitively to special leaf images. Entity.getEntityPosition maps only port and the entry, exit, pin, and expansion-position stereotypes away from NORMAL; Entity.isAutarkic tests that semantic position and cross-boundary links, not mere stereotype presence. For an autarkic group, GroupMakerState still builds its autonomous image. EntityImageStateCommon and InnerStateAutonom merge the base state/title/header/body signatures with the entity or group stereotype. The merged font metrics determine each image dimension before SvekNode emits DOT dimensions, while merged fill, line, text, stroke, rounding, and shadow channels paint that same image. Explicit entity colors and strokes override merged style channels. An unmatched selector and an ordinary unmatched stereotype therefore leave geometry and paint unchanged.
causal_divergence: Rust preserves an ordinary stereotype string but rejects every stereotyped composite and every stereotyped child before autonomous layout, regardless of semantic entity position or image kind. It also accepts only nodesep and ranksep in the autonomous path, so any state style selector forces a different renderer even when the selector matches no entity. The autonomous size and paint model uses one diagram-global StateSkin rather than resolving the base plus stereotype-qualified style for each ordinary state and composite. Consequently ordinary labels such as mytype, deepHistory, and composite are treated as layout blockers instead of style selectors, and stereotype-selected font metrics cannot reach DOT node dimensions.
planned_change: Recognize Java's reserved pseudostate stereotypes case-insensitively in the parser. Replace blanket stereotype rejection with a semantic autonomous-eligibility predicate: non-normal position stereotypes remain outside this autonomous renderer, while ordinary style stereotypes are eligible; specialized image decorations that Rust does not yet generate remain explicitly unsupported rather than silently painted as plain boxes. Resolve each ordinary state and composite from the diagram base style plus its matching stereotype-qualified state skinparams. Feed the resolved title and attribute font metrics into node and wrapper dimensions before layout, and use the same resolved fill, border, text, thickness, rounding, and shadow channels during emission, preserving explicit entity fill/stroke precedence. Treat unmatched state selectors as inert for autonomous eligibility. Do not branch on fixture labels, special-case a stereotype merely because it appears in the golden corpus, or allow a visual value to alter geometry unless the corresponding Java style channel does.
